scripts.translation:

[Artifact Collector]
You seem like a pretty good judge of character.

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
For over 200 years I've been working with Artifacts here in Mora. Toiling to get the perfect +9!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我在穆拉研究神器已经超过200年了。为了打造完美的+9神器，我付出了无数的心血！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
My business is collecting the old relics and refining them to their essence!
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
我的工作是收集古老的遗物，并提炼出它们的精华！

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Finding the perfect Artifact for me to experiment on is my life's work.
Plus seeing the wonder of our ancestor's legacy is also gratifying.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
寻找完美的神器供我实验，是我毕生的事业。
此外，见证祖先留下的奇迹遗产，也是一件令人欣慰的事。

scripts.text: I can see how that could be fun.
scripts.translation: 我明白那确实很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Thank you human.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]

[Artifact Collector]
I've been doing this for over 200 years, and honestly the readily available supply is gone, and Artificer and Artifact Crafter won't trade me anymore...
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Ultimate Achievement?
scripts.translation: 终极成就？

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Patience, we'll get to that...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
I am a collector, by trade, but my greatest achievement is empowering some artifacts with greater power!
I have only perfected my ability on a few Artifact types so far.
scripts.translation:

我的职业是收藏家，但我最大的成就是赋予某些神器更强大的力量！
目前，我只在少数几种神器上完美掌握了这项能力。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
You might just be the human to help me complete my plan.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
你也许就是那个能帮我完成计划的人类。

scripts.text:
[Artifact Collector]
Oh how I love how fate works sometimes...
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
命运有时真是奇妙...

scripts.text:

+1, +2, +3, +4, +5, +6 those refinements are not strong enough to work on my craft.
scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]
+1, +2, +3, +4, +5, +6，这些强化等级还不够强，无法用于我的工艺。

scripts.translation:
[神器收藏家]

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.

scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
With my touch, I can turn a typical army padding into a piece of art. I'm Kay the Master Tailor, creating art with army paddings.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
凭借我的手艺，我能将普通的军用内衣变成艺术品。我是裁缝大师凯，用军用内衣创造艺术。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Well, what's in a name? I can turn your army padding into a piece of art if you bring ^ff00005 Mora Coins and an Army Padding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
名字什么的无所谓。只要你带着^ff00005枚穆拉村硬币和一件军用内衣^000000，我就能把它变成艺术品。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I happen to have a few army paddings in stock. Would you like to buy one? The price is 1 Mora Coin. So cheap.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
我正好有几件军用内衣存货。你想买一件吗？只要1枚穆拉村硬币。很便宜吧。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text: I'll buy one now.
scripts.translation: 我现在买一件

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Okay, I understand.
Come back for one if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
好的，我明白了。
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Here it is.
It's very nice and fluffy. Please come back.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
给你。
非常柔软蓬松。请下次再来。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Have you come to add art to one of your army paddings?
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
你是来给你的军用内衣增添艺术感的吗？

scripts.text: Please tell me more.
scripts.translation: 请多告诉我一些

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
A typical army padding isn't warm enough. It feels rough on your skin and doesn't look good. And artistic value? It has next to none.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
普通的军用内衣不够保暖。穿在身上粗糙，外观也不好看。至于艺术价值？几乎为零。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
However, I'll embroider it with velvet threads, and add three options to it.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
不过，我会用天鹅绒线进行刺绣，并添加三个选项。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Bring me ^8888005 Mora Coins^000000 and an Army Padding, and we can add some art together!
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
带着^8888005枚穆拉村硬币^000000和一件军用内衣来找我，我们一起创造艺术吧！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I'm telling you just in case - I'll do whatever I need to do with your army padding, whether it's brand-new or has been mended before.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
顺便提醒一下——无论你的军用内衣是全新的还是修补过的，我都会按我的方式处理。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
So if you have with you an army padding mended to your liking, put it in a safe place and come back.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
所以，如果你有一件修补得合心意的军用内衣，请把它放在安全的地方，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
And another thing - once I fail to add art to it, it becomes unusable... you'll need to buy a new one in that case.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
还有一件事——如果我添加艺术效果失败，它就会变得无法使用...到时候你需要买一件新的。

scripts.text: Come on, what's the rush?
scripts.translation: 别急，慢慢来

scripts.text: Okay! Let's do it!!
scripts.translation: 好的！开始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
What's wrong with you?
The villagers keep me busy enough.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
你怎么了？
村民们已经让我忙得不可开交了。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
看起来你缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
You have to have 5 Mora Coins and an Army Padding with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
在我开始工作之前，你必须携带5枚穆拉村硬币和一件军用内衣。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
Oh......
I can't believe I messed up.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
噢......
真不敢相信我搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
I want to be alone. Go away!
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
我想一个人静一静。请离开！

scripts.text:
[Master Tailor]
My art looks great.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝大师]
我的手艺真不错。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
My job is to polish the stone in a Guardian's Pendant, and then carve a symbol with special power on it.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
我的工作是为<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠打磨石头，并在上面雕刻出拥有特殊力量的符文。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
The process gives the Guardian's Pendant more power than an ordinary accessory.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
这个过程会让<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠比普通的饰品拥有更强的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
If you're interested, I can work on your pendant for ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000. Of course you need to have a Guardian's Pendant so I can work on with you.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
如果您感兴趣，我可以为您加工<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠，费用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬币^000000。当然，您需要携带一个<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠，我才能为您加工。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
Have you come to have your Guardian's Pendant upgraded?
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
您是来升级<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠的吗？

scripts.text: Please tell me more.
scripts.translation: 请多告诉我一些

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

这个过程会让<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠比普通的饰品拥有更强的力量。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
如果您感兴趣，我可以为您加工<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠，费用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬币^000000。当然，您需要携带一个<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠，我才能为您加工。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
I'm telling you just in case - 
If I work on a Guardian's Pendant that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
我提前告诉您一下——
如果我加工一个已经升级过的<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠，它会失去原本的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
And worse, it can lose its power and become an ordinary pendant. Of course, stone is not as susceptible to damage as cloth, so you won't lose the pendant itself.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
更糟糕的是，它可能会失去力量，变成普通的吊坠。当然，石头不像布料那样容易损坏，所以您不会失去吊坠本身。

scripts.text: Come on, what's the rush?
scripts.translation: 别急，慢慢来

scripts.text: Okay! Let's do it!!
scripts.translation: 好的！开始吧！！

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
Come back when you're not in a hurry. I always have a lot of time on my hands.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
等您不忙的时候再来吧。我手头总是有很多时间。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
看起来您缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Guardian's Pendant with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
在我开始工作之前，您必须携带5枚穆拉村硬币和一个<黑暗搜集者>华丽金属守卫的吊坠。

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
What~!!
What on earth is wrong with it!!
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
什么~！！
这到底是怎么回事！！

scripts.text:
[Pendant Crafter]
Looks like I did it!
scripts.translation:
[吊坠工匠]
看起来我成功了！

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了，无法进行该操作。请丢弃一些物品后再试。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I'm Bulberry Westhood, keeping the tradition of quality hoods alive.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
我是布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德，致力于传承优质兜帽的传统。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
我只处理优质物品——而不是市场上随便买的围巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
If you have anything that you think is of high enough quality, come find me with ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
如果您有认为足够优质的物品，请带着^ff00005枚穆拉村硬币^000000来找我。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I can improve its high quality with my own hands.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
我可以用我的双手提升它的高品质。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
So you have a Loki's Scarf 1042 Special Edition. You really have an eye for quality. Can I start working on it right away?
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
原来您有一条洛基围巾 1042 特别版。您的眼光真不错。我可以马上开始工作吗？

scripts.text: I don't get it.
scripts.translation: 我不明白。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Like I said, I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
正如我所说的，我只处理优质物品——而不是市场上随便买的围巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
This Loki's Scarf you have is awesome. It's a limited edition product with Loki's crest on it!
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
您这条洛基围巾真是了不起。这是带有洛基纹章的限量版产品！

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
My specialty is bringing out the hidden power at the small cost of... 
5 Mora Coins.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
我的专长是挖掘其隐藏的力量，代价仅为...
5枚穆拉村硬币。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
如果您改变主意了，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
I'm telling you just in case - 
If I work on a Loki's Scarf that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
我事先说明一下——
如果我加工一条已经升级过的洛基围巾，它会失去原有的力量。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
And worse, it can lose all its power becoming an ordinary scarf.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
更糟糕的是，它可能会失去所有力量，变成一条普通的围巾。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Of course, the Loki's Scarf is a quality item, so you won't lose the scarf itself in the process.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
当然，洛基围巾是优质物品，所以在过程中您不会失去围巾本身。

scripts.text: Maybe later, sir...
scripts.translation: 也许以后吧，先生...

scripts.text: I'd like to own a quality item!
scripts.translation: 我想拥有一件优质物品！

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Ha...!
You say 'later' when you can have the best quality item right away? Well, have it your own way.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
哈...！
明明现在就能拥有最高品质的物品，您却说“以后”？好吧，随您便。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
It looks like you don't everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
看来您还没有准备好所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Loki's Scarf with you before you can have the best quality item.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
您需要持有5枚穆拉村硬币和一条洛基围巾，才能获得最高品质的物品。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Aaarrgghh, this is impossible!
My! My Loki's Scarf!....
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
啊...啊...这不可能！
我的！我的洛基围巾！....

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Oh, I apologize for my disgraceful behavior. I was too upset.
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
噢，我为我失态的行为道歉。我太激动了。

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Fortunately, it's still in its original state before I started working on it. It's not torn or stretched. It's a quality item after all. Oh ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
幸好，它在我开始工作前还保持着原始状态。没有撕裂或变形。毕竟是优质物品嘛。哦呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Bulberry Westhood]
Wow~ mission complete!
scripts.translation:
[布尔贝里·韦斯特胡德]
哇~任务完成！
